certainty_reasoning: Married, on the same per-marriage-footnoted Wikipedia article as the Gregg marriage - see gregg--wilkinson for the article's citation apparatus and why it is trusted further than Le Gallienne's.
date_label: married after 1932; ended in divorce, date unrecorded
summary: Louis Wilkinson's third wife, married after Ann Reid's death in 1932 and divorced at an unrecorded date. Nothing else about her appears in anything read - she is the least documented of the four wives, resting on a single Who Was Who mention.

sources.quote: Wilkinson then married Diana Bryn; his fourth wife was Joan Lamburn, a writer of children's stories, who died in 1956.
sources.context: Wikipedia, 'Louis Wilkinson', 'Personal life' - the sentence covering the third and fourth marriages together. Neither wedding is dated. The third marriage is supported on the page only by the Who Was Who entry, 'Wilkinson, Louis Umfreville (Louis Marlow)'.
sources.supports: The third marriage and the wife's name.
